boundaries.falsifier: Any external side effect without a receipt.
boundaries.name: ZERO_UNRECEIPTED_ACTUATION
boundaries.rule: Every material consequence requires a receipt.

boundaries.falsifier: An O record used as O* without validation.
boundaries.name: OBSERVATION_IS_NOT_ADMISSION

boundaries.falsifier: A non-BRCE capability performs direct consequential actuation.
boundaries.name: CONSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ACTUATION
boundaries.rule: ggen, planners, Graphlaw, and hooks construct artifacts or intents only.

boundaries.falsifier: A relationship or report where producer and independent verifier are identical without an admitted external cross-check.
boundaries.name: NO_SELF_CERTIFICATION
boundaries.rule: The producer cannot grant standing to itself.

boundaries.falsifier: A component check directly sets ecosystem ALIVE.
boundaries.name: CHECKPOINT_IS_NOT_CROWN
boundaries.rule: Local success cannot promote ecosystem standing.

boundaries.falsifier: A repository object is treated as the capability ontology.
boundaries.name: REPOSITORIES_REALIZE_CAPABILITIES
boundaries.rule: Repository identity and capability identity remain distinct.

boundaries.falsifier: A capability is rejected only because it is absent from the cohort.
boundaries.name: COHORT_IS_NOT_ECOSYSTEM
boundaries.rule: The 2026-07-31 cohort is a bounded repository observation, not the complete ecosystem boundary.
